description: This file defines a PHP class 'Api' within the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically in the catalog model for settings. It provides methods for API authentication, session management, and interaction with the database related to API access.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Model class handling API authentication and session management in OpenCart.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user via username and key, returning API info.

methods.name: getApiByToken
methods.description: Retrieves API session information using a session token.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Fetches API session records for a specific API ID.

methods.name: deleteSessions
methods.description: Deletes old or expired API sessions for a specific API ID.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the last modified timestamp for a session to keep it active.

methods.name: cleanSessions
methods.description: Deletes all expired API sessions from the database.
